samples.summary: The new `USAGE` code is documented in §8.1 but §10 "Error Matrix" — the canonical per-case Exit/Code/Message table listing every other code (TYPE_MISMATCH, INVALID_DOCX, CONFIRMATION_REQ, …) — gains no row for argument-parsing failures (exit 1, `USAGE`), so the doc now states the contract in two places with one incomplete.
samples.evidence: docs/design/cli.md §10 table (lines 1049-1065) has no USAGE row; the diff only touches §8.1 (lines 780-801).

samples.summary: Every non-help `CommanderError` is flattened to the single code `USAGE`, and the no-op `outputError` hook is installed program-wide. That covers the three cases the doc names, but it also pre-empts future command-level validation routed through commander (`Command.error()`, `InvalidArgumentError` from an `argParser`, `--format` choice checks): those would surface as `USAGE` instead of a command-specific branchable code, contrary to the typed-code convention in packages/cli/README.md:116-122. Worth documenting that all commander-originated failures are deliberately one code.
samples.evidence: cli.ts:87 `outputError(new UsageError(e.message.replace(/^error: /, '')))` for all non-HELP_CODES CommanderErrors; root.ts:54-58 installs a blanket no-op `outputError`.
